protocols.name: x402
protocols.summary: HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header naming accepted schemes, networks and amounts; the client retries the same request with a signed stablecoin payment and a facilitator settles it. Open standard, Apache-2.0, stewarded by the x402 Foundation.

protocols.name: Machine Payments Protocol
protocols.summary: HTTP 402 with a WWW-Authenticate: Payment challenge carrying a method, an intent (charge or session) and a base64 request; payment-method agnostic, with Tempo stablecoins, cards via Stripe and Lightning documented; the core scheme is submitted to the IETF.
